gtso bo'i bsnyen pa 'bru bcu bdun pa ni/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa dzaḥhūm̐ āḥ khro bcu yab yum za gsod ni/ oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐/ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha nī la daṇḍa hūm̐/ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ya mānta ka hūm̐/ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ārya a tsa la hūm̐/ bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ha ya grī ba hūm̐/ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐/ tiṣṭha tiṣṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha a mṛta kuṇḍa lī hūm̐/ tstshindha tstshindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐/ bhindha bhindha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐/ spho ṭa spho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ sras mchog nyer gcig ni/ oṃ badzra kro dha kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sgo bzhi srung mar bcas pa ni/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya/ mo hā ghā ta ya ma ma shī ghraṃ karma ka ra ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ spu gri'i drag sngags 'dus pa ni/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa dzaḥhūm̐ ā: ma rag mo yag mo: kā la rū pa snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ: srog la yaṃ yaṃ: snying la phril phril: srog la chum chum: tsitta srog la tung tung: snying khrag srog la shad shad: thuṃ ri li li: tseg tseg: 'ur 'ur: shig shig: gul gul: myags myags: sod sod: ḍā ki ma ma karma: shī ghraṃ ka ra ye: mā ra se na: pra mārdha na ye hūm̐ phaṭa: ༈ thun mtshams su stong tshigs kyi mchod pa ni/ sman gtor rakta'i mchod pa gzhung bzhin phul nas/ hūm̐/ dpal chen phur bu'i lha tshogs gshegs// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul// sku gsung thugs yon 'phrin las bstod// bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags// thugs rjes brtser dgongs dngos grub stsol// ces dngos grub blang ngo*//

༈ //rtags gdab pa ni/ mo mo dang mkha' 'gro rnams kyi rang gi sde tshan du ngo shes par bya ba'i phyir gdab ste/ rtsi 'du byas la/ hūm̐/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang dam tshig gcig pa dang*// sangs rgyas sa gsum dag la 'god bya'i phyir// lkog mar zhag gi zo ris mtshan mas gdab// oṃ badzra ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas lkog mar zhag gi zo ris zla gam/ hūm̐/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang dam tshig gcig pa dang*// sangs rgyas sa gsum dag la 'god bya'i phyir// dpral bar thal chen tshom bu'i mtshan mas gdab// oṃ badzra ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ dpra bar thal chen rtse gsum ris/ hūm̐/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang dam tshig gcig pa dang*// sangs rgyas sa gsum dag la 'god bya'i phyir// shangs dang mkhur tshos rakta'i mtshan mas gdab// oṃ badzra ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'bur gsum la khrag gi thig le rnams ma 'chol bar gdab cing*/ spro na rtags gsum gyi gong du/ bgo ba'i gos gsum dang*/ gdags pa'i rgyan gnyis te dur khrod kyi chas brgyad ka tshang ba'i chas su 'jug tshul kyang 'byung ngo*// ༈ //'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ gsang rgyud las/ hoḥ bskal pa dpag tu med pa tshun chod nas// da lta'i dus 'di bskyed pa phan chad du// lha mchog khyed dang smon lam mthu bsdebs nas// dus 'dir zhal mthong yi dam lhar gsol na// dus tshigs 'di nas bzung nas yi dam lha// snying po byang chub mchog la mi gnas tshun// tshe rabs 'khor ba gar byung gar skyes kyang*// gsang ba'i lha mchog khyed dang mi 'bral zhing*// spyi dang khyad par lhag pa'i dam tshig las// mi 'da' ba dang yun du bdag bsrung gis// chad lhag 'gal 'khrul mchis na mthol lo bshags// bar chod rkyen gyis rnam smin ci byung yang*// dpal chen khyod kyis mod la zil gyis gnon// dngos grub mchog stsol shes rab lha mo'i tshogs//
zhes dang dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying brjod la bshags so// //
